evidence.notes: Direct-object construction in both documented senses: consulter un médecin (seek advice) and consulter un dictionnaire (look up information).
Constructed with prepositions, never a direct object: correspondre à (to match) and correspondre avec (to exchange letters), as the usage note states.
Intransitive crier (to shout) and transitive crier quelque chose (to shout something out), both standard.
Intransitive with de/avec (discuter de quelque chose, discuter avec quelqu'un) and transitive (discuter un sujet, discuter le prix).
Primary sense intransitive (débarquer = to get off/disembark, matching the gloss); transitive use also standard for unloading goods (débarquer des marchandises).
